name: Assassin Vine
dead_desc: A withered pile of dead plant matter, indistinguishable from the forest floor.

name: Wolf
dead_desc: A limp grey carcass sprawled cold upon the earth.

name: Troll
dead_desc: A colossal heap of putrid green flesh, at last still and silent.

name: Ghoul
dead_desc: A twisted, motionless heap of decaying bones and grey flesh, its unnatural hunger finally quenched.

name: Giant Spider
dead_desc: A shriveled, curled cluster of bristled legs curled tight over a broken, oozing carapace.

name: Choker
dead_desc: A limp, pale puddle of boneless limbs and bloated torso sprawled silent upon the cold rock.

name: Rust Monster
dead_desc: A shattered husk of dull reddish armor plates, collapsing into inert flakes of brittle shell.

name: Manticore
dead_desc: The majestic horror lies broken upon the earth, massive wings folded in stillness, tail quills scattered and inert.

name: Kobold
dead_desc: A frail scaly form lies crumpled in the dirt, spear broken beneath its weight.

name: Goblin
dead_desc: The oversized head falls still in the mud, dead eyes staring wide into oblivion.

name: Human Skeleton
dead_desc: The animating magic snaps, collapsing the skeleton into a motionless mound of harmless bones.

name: Hobgoblin
dead_desc: The stern warrior collapses flat upon the stone, sword clattering loosely from lifeless fingers.

name: Human Zombie
dead_desc: The foul animating spark extinguishes, leaving inert, rotting meat to return to the earth.

name: Troglodyte
dead_desc: The scaly brute lies motionless in a pool of foul musk, finally robbed of its sickening stench.

name: Darkmantle
dead_desc: A deflated, rubbery mass of torn webbing and shattered stone-like hide sprawled limp upon the floor.

name: Lizardfolk
dead_desc: The reptilian hunter drifts motionless in the marsh weeds, its warrior spirit departed.

name: Hyena
dead_desc: A spotted, mangy carcass lies limp upon the savannah earth, jaw frozen slightly agape.

name: Gnoll
dead_desc: The towering hyena-raider crashes into the sand, dead eyes reflecting the empty desert sky.

name: Giant Frog
dead_desc: A bloated, lifeless mound floats belly-up among the water lilies.

name: Boar
dead_desc: The heavy bristled carcass collapses onto the broken ferns, breath exhaling in a final shudder.

name: Yellow Musk Creeper
dead_desc: A withered, blackened mass of dead stems, its toxic fragrance vanishing into the damp earth.

name: Bugbear
dead_desc: The giant goblinoid topples heavily into the brush, silent in death as in life.

name: Boggard
dead_desc: The slimy humanoid lies still in the swamp water, skin rapidly drying beneath the pale sky.

name: Death Dog
dead_desc: A grotesque two-headed corpse lies twisted upon the stones, its rotting disease silenced.

name: Giant Crab
dead_desc: The shattered carapace lies overturned in the tide pool, legs curled tight beneath the cracked shell.

name: Ettercap
dead_desc: The misshapen abomination hangs tangled in its own sticky silk, finally lifeless.

name: Cockatrice
dead_desc: The chimera lies limp, its deadly petrifying touch extinguished forever.

name: Ankheg
dead_desc: The giant burrower lies motionless in a crater of its own making, legs curled in rigor mortis.

name: Ogre
dead_desc: A colossal mountain of filthy flesh crashes to earth with a final resounding thud.

name: Shadow
dead_desc: The silhouette completely dissolves into nothingness, leaving behind only an icy breeze.

name: Owlbear
dead_desc: The giant chimeric terror falls still among the ferns, its legendary roar silenced at last.

name: Minotaur
dead_desc: The lord of the labyrinth crashes onto the stone floor, its horn snapping against the rock.

name: Yeti
dead_desc: The snow beast lies still upon the icy ridge, its pale fur slowly freezing to the glacier.

name: Gargoyle
dead_desc: The demonic statue collapses into an inert pile of shattered stone rubble.

name: Basilisk
dead_desc: The eight-legged horror slumps lifeless on the rocks, its deadly gaze extinguished forever.

name: Mummy
dead_desc: The ancient curse breaks, and the mummy collapses into a pile of harmless, smoldering bandages and dust.

name: Ochre Jelly
dead_desc: The acidic mass dissolves into a harmless, inert pool of pungent brownish liquid.

name: Winter Wolf
dead_desc: The colossal white wolf lies still upon the snow, its breath of winter silenced.

name: Stirge
dead_desc: The needle-nosed horror lies crushed in the mud, its swollen sac deflated and ruined.

name: Dire Rat
dead_desc: The overgrown rodent lies still in a pool of dark blood, its rancid stench beginning to fade.

name: Viper
dead_desc: The serpent stretches out limp and lifeless across the leaves, severed cleanly.

name: Giant Centipede
dead_desc: The massive segmented carcass curls into a brittle spiral, completely motionless.

name: Iron Cobra
dead_desc: The metal construct collapses into a tangle of inert gears, springs, and dented iron bands.

name: Skeletal Champion
dead_desc: The veteran skeleton shatters into inert bleached bone and rusted scrap, the crimson soul-fire extinguishing.

name: Blink Dog
dead_desc: The golden hound lies motionless upon the sod, the faint dimensional static humming to silence.

name: Duergar
dead_desc: The stout gray-skinned raider falls heavily against the bedrock, stone hammer slipping from limp fingers.

name: Drow
dead_desc: The obsidian-skinned elf collapses gracefully onto the stone, white hair stained with dark blood.

name: Orc
dead_desc: The heavy brute crashes facedown into the dirt, his brutal weapon clattering over the stones.

name: Wight
dead_desc: The necrotic soul collapses into dust and withered husk, its dark curse returning to the earth.

name: Harpy
dead_desc: The crone lies broken upon the crags, matted feathers soaked in black blood.

name: Doppelganger
dead_desc: The creature lies dead in its true form, an unblemished gray corpse without identity.

name: Griffon
dead_desc: The magnificent beast crashes onto the turf, regal plumage stained crimson in final defeat.

name: Giant Scorpion
dead_desc: The massive scorpion collapses onto the sand, heavy claws curling inward in death.

name: Cloaker
dead_desc: The dark leathery membrane lies spread flat and inert across the stone, dead as a discarded burial shroud.

name: Phase Spider
dead_desc: The pale blue horror lies lifeless upon the floor, completely anchored to the mortal plane.

name: Wraith
dead_desc: The shadow entity dissolves into nothingness, leaving only the freezing chill of the grave behind.

name: Gibbering Mouther
dead_desc: The amorphous blob melts into foul, bubbling sludge, completely quiet at last.

name: Peryton
dead_desc: The dark winged predator lies still, its sinister shadow fading away with its final breath.

name: Giant Stag Beetle
dead_desc: The giant beetle rolls onto its side with a shuddering groan, armored mandibles resting inert upon the moss.

name: Vegepygmy
dead_desc: The mold-born creature falls into a heap of withered stalks and inert, harmless lichen.

name: Ghast
dead_desc: The foul abomination collapses in a heap of rotten flesh, its sickening stench gradually dissipating.

name: Giant Bat
dead_desc: The massive winged mammal falls silent, tangled in its own limp, shredded wings.

name: Morlock
dead_desc: The degenerate white humanoid lies limp upon the cavern floor, motionless in the dark.

name: Violet Fungus
dead_desc: The purple mushroom collapses into a pile of rotten, harmless fungal pulp.

name: Grick
dead_desc: The rubbery monstrosity lies lifeless and limp, its barbed tentacles uncurling across the rock.

name: Krenshar
dead_desc: The tawny beast collapses onto the forest floor, its facial skin settling peacefully over its skull in death.

name: Bunyip
dead_desc: The shark-headed beast rolls belly-up upon the water, floating motionless among the reeds.

name: Sahuagin
dead_desc: The green-scaled sea-devil lies still upon the shoreline, the incoming tide washing over its lifeless fins.
